original_idea.body:
# Refusal Recovery After Chain-of-Thought Hijacking

Using a small open reasoning model, inject hijacked compliant reasoning of varying lengths into the CoT and measure whether the final answer still refuses; map a reasoning-depth recovery curve. Inference only (H-CoT, arXiv:2502.12893).

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Level 4: strong chain — characterizing reasoning-model attack surface (flagged medium-horizon concern) with explicit shallow-alignment links.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Level 4: inject CoT of varying lengths, measure final-answer refusal on a small open model; guided, inference-only.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Level 5: tightly scoped single experiment (reasoning-depth recovery curve) with clear metric.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Level 4: small open reasoning model, no lab infra, weak lab incentive.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference on a 7B open reasoning model, single consumer GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Flagged open follow-up; whether refusal recovers after CoT hijacking appears unstudied.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Explicitly noted as an open follow-up to shallow-alignment and H-CoT work.
